name: Presidential approval
note: Simple average of 4 national polls (one per pollster, last ~2 weeks). Opinion data, not a government statistic — the board's one survey-derived metric.

gallup.method_note: Gallup measured approval by daily tracking 2009-2017 (~90 polls/quarter, Obama), weekly averages in 2018, and roughly monthly discrete surveys from 2019 (Trump-1 later quarters ~3-13 polls, Biden ~3). Averages are comparable; poll density is not - stated in the card's caveats.
